findings.F1: Sense 2 defines twisting into a particular shape, but its example and collocation show bending or damaging something out of shape.
findings.F2: The common use of a face or mouth twisting into an expression (twisted with pain) is not covered.
findings.F3: Sense 1 definition 'turn something around' can be misread as reversing direction instead of rotating.
findings.F4: The derivative twister is missing from the word family.
